EC-003.note: File > Open Image from URL… (no default shortcut) opens a guarded dialog; nothing is requested until the user presses Download. The policy lives in Qt Core src/image-editor/ImageUrl: https only by default, plain http only through a per-request, clearly labelled checkbox, other schemes, userinfo, empty hosts, control characters and over-long URLs refused with stable url-* codes; redirects are limited to 5, every target is re-validated and https->http is never followed even with the opt-in. app/UrlDownload (QNetworkAccessManager, manual redirects, no cache/cookies, 30 s no-progress timeout) enforces the 1 GiB encoded cap (equal to the shared RasterSource ceiling, static_assert) both from Content-Length and while streaming, so an oversized body is aborted mid-transfer. Content-Type is not trusted: bytes go through the shared RasterSource decoder (header/pixel limits, orientation, alpha/profile) inside an owned EditorOpen worker with progress and Cancel, then the existing dirty-session Save/Discard/Cancel flow, and are adopted as an untitled unsaved session exactly like New Image. Cancel, Escape, dialog close and owner destruction abort the transfer. Local-copy outcome: bytes are held in memory only, no file is written (Qt disk cache disabled); the dialog states that the server sees the request and IP, and the status line says no local copy was kept. The title/status show only host[:port], never path, query or credentials. Native tests (image-url, url-download, editor-url-open) cover valid PNG into a session, corrupt/non-image content with the session unchanged, size cap mid-stream, too many redirects, bad redirect targets, cancel mid-download, timeout, owner destruction, plain-http refusal and dirty Cancel/Discard. TLS evidence: a loopback QSslServer fixture with checked-in test-only certificates (tests/tls, regenerated by tests/tls/generate.sh; CA key discarded) is trusted only through the downloader's test seam (setExtraTrustedCas); production configuration is untouched. Native tests verify https success (IP and DNS names) with the trusted CA, refusal of a CA-signed cert when the CA is not trusted, a self-signed cert, and a hostname mismatch with the stable url-tls-failed code and no HTTP request sent, an https->http redirect refused over real TLS even with the http opt-in, and the editor session left unchanged after TLS refusal. Product decisions recorded: 1 GiB cap tied to the decoder cap; opted-in http->http cross-host redirects allowed with re-validation; disposition Required. Human privacy/security review of the feature remains a release gate outside this native requirement; proxy-specific behaviour is not separately exercised.

EC-009.note: Resize Image has pixel dimensions distinct from display scale (viewport zoom never changes pixels; CanvasOperationsTest and EditorViewportTest), aspect locking, validated interpolation (nearest, alpha-aware bilinear) and dimension limits, and carries every stored annotation type through one shared affine routine. Determinations by Aoife under Mike's similar-apps rule, from the reference app (ShareX.ImageEditor Core/Editor/EditorCore.cs ScaleAnnotations, Core/Annotations/Base/Annotation.cs Scale, Text/TextAnnotation.cs Scale): resize never refuses; stroke width *= min(sx,sy); Text/SpeechBalloon font size *= sy; Step with no stored size follows its box; effect strength is not rescaled; local box extents scale by the world factors and an off-quarter rotated object under unequal factors is a documented deterministic approximation (CANVAS-POLICY.md). Unknown (UnsupportedAnnotation) objects refuse the whole operation by the contract's data-preservation rule. AnnotationTransformTest covers every type x transform. Shared goldens and target qualification remain the usual non-blocking qualification note.
